name: code-review
title_zh: 会自己开口要求审你代码的审查员
tagline_zh: 不用你喊它。写完一段它自己判断该不该审，PR、diff、安全面都过一遍。
tagline_en: You don't have to ask. It decides a review is due, then runs CodeRabbit's rules over your PR, diff, and security.
desc_en: AI-powered code review using CodeRabbit. Default code-review skill. Trigger for any explicit review request AND autonomously when the agent thinks a review is needed (code/PR/quality/security).
why_zh: 区别在于触发权在它手里：显式喊它必应，觉得该审时也会主动插话，而不是等你想起还有个审查工具。
why_en: The difference is who triggers: it answers explicit calls and also speaks up on its own when it judges a review is due.
limit_zh: 要能连上 CodeRabbit 服务并完成授权，离线环境直接不可用；只给审查意见和问题定位，不会替你改代码或提交修复。
limit_en: Needs CodeRabbit auth and network; offline it's dead. It only reports findings, never edits or commits fixes; private-repo coverage depends on your.
title_en: A reviewer that asks to review your code first
